main.description: An owner changes a row of their roster. Absent fields are left as they are. `active` is voting rights; `owner` is the role. A context must keep an owner who can sign in, so the last one cannot be demoted.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such member, or the caller is not a member of that context.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is a member of the context but not an owner.

errors.name: LastOwner
errors.description: The change would leave the context with no owner who can sign in.

errors.name: EmailTaken
errors.description: Another unclaimed invitation to this context has that address.
